metadata.notes: twapCancel is an L1 action (phantom-agent scheme), signed exactly like `order` — the wrapper dispatches it to the agent tier. `a` is the asset index, `t` is the TWAP id returned by `twapOrder`'s `running.twapId` (not an order id — `cancel`'s `o` field is a different identifier space). msgpack is the exact preimage keccak-hashed (with nonce/vaultAddress/expiresAfter appended as raw bytes, per action_hash()) to build the phantom-agent EIP-712 message that source/connectionId wraps.
